title: Listen: a private podcast feed for books
reason: R3 found a secret-token podcast feed the strongest option for locked and offline listening, but it hands a long-lived URL, and for some apps the audio, to third-party servers. The operator signed the design with 'no podcast feed for now' (OQ2, P41-sr.D1).
trigger: The web player fails the operator's screen-off iPhone check at P41-sr's acceptance, or the operator asks for offline listening.
